==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Shui:''' Hey, are you interested in Overdash too?
:'''Shui:''' I get it, since Overdash is a sport with a long history and wide audience.
:'''Shui:''' Not only does it strengthen your body, it may as well save your life in a pinch.
:'''Shui:''' It's true. I heard that during the war, those who could master the Overdash technique survived better than those who couldn't.
:'''Shui:''' And, speaking of which...
:'''Shui:''' I have to mention the connection I've had with Overdash since birth!
:'''Shui:''' If it weren't for my mom being... uh... captivated by my dad's Overdash on the training field... Well, I wouldn't be here today!
:{{DIcon}} ?
:'''Shui:''' I'm getting off track here... What I'm trying to say is, Overdash might just bring you some unexpected connections!
:'''Shui:''' So, does it sound exciting, right?
:'''Shui:''' We Overdash enthusiasts have formed a fan club, and we're eagerly recruiting new members!
:'''Shui:''' Once you join, you'll have senior members to guide you, various offline activities to participate in, and even international exchange competitions!
:'''Shui:''' Unlike those clubs, we won't charge you for entry! It's totally free!
:'''Shui:''' Absolutely no membership fees of any kind! Just leave an e-signature here on the terminal...
:{{DIcon}} ...
:'''Shui:''' Hey, hey, hey, hey, don't go—
{{Dialogue End}}
